description: The file defines utility functions within the beerocks::bpl::utils namespace, including string trimming, string to integer conversion, integer to hex string conversion, and checking if STP (Spanning Tree Protocol) is enabled on a bridge.

methods.name: ltrim
methods.description: Removes leading characters from a string, with optional additional characters to trim.

methods.name: rtrim
methods.description: Removes trailing characters from a string, with optional additional characters to trim.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes both leading and trailing characters from a string, with optional additional characters to trim.

methods.name: stoi
methods.description: Converts a string to a 64-bit integer.

methods.name: int_to_hex_string
methods.description: Converts an unsigned integer to a hexadecimal string representation with a specified number of digits.

methods.name: is_stp_enabled
methods.description: Checks if the Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) is enabled on a network bridge.
